regressions.found: 2026-09-25, review of the EPR-008 DI-9 unlock (PR #41), which requires Actor::User in the same UserQuestionAnswered arm of rebuild
regressions.defect: rebuild's UserQuestionAnswered arm set scope_answer from any answer on the task while a scope question was pending, whatever its actor and whichever question it answered: an answer the agent wrote, or the user's later answer to an earlier question, decided the scope expansion.
regressions.audit: IMPLEMENTED-PARTIAL: the unlock was production-wired, but its input was bound to neither its author nor its question; first missing link the UserQuestionAnswered arm of rebuild in services/modbit-core/src/runtime.rs.
regressions.fix: rebuild marks the questions asked while scope_question_pending is non-empty as scope questions; only an Actor::User answer to one of them, consumed by its first answer, sets scope_answer. No new event or field.
regressions.negative_proof: Run before the fix: on the unfixed Core an agent-written continue let the retried lockfile write land (local-red-unfixed.log); with the actor check alone the user's later continue to an earlier question overrode their stop (local-red-actor-check-only.log).
regressions.limitations: ScopeExpansionRecorded was still recorded under the agent actor and rebuild applied a CONTINUE whatever its actor, and rebuild kept the answer after replaying the decision made from it; both are follow-up regressions (PR #53).

regressions.audit: IMPLEMENTED-PARTIAL; first missing link the ScopeExpansionRecorded arm of rebuild in services/modbit-core/src/runtime.rs.

regressions.found: 2026-09-25, the limitation recorded by the scope-answer-actor regression
regressions.defect: ScopeExpansionRecorded was appended under the run's agent actor and rebuild applied a CONTINUE whatever its actor, so a CONTINUE written straight into the log (EventStore::append with the Core down) opened an out-of-scope write after a restart, before any scope question or against the user's stop.
regressions.audit: IMPLEMENTED-PARTIAL; first missing link the CONTINUE branch of the ScopeExpansionRecorded arm of rebuild. Every writer (run_loop only) and reader (rebuild only; accounting, baseline, attention, branch, doc 63 metrics and clients do not depend on this event's actor) traced; payload and schema_version unchanged, docs/30 fixes no actor, no locked file changed: no Decision Record.
regressions.fix: both writers record as Actor::Core("scope-policy") and the loop opens paths only once its CONTINUE is on the log; rebuild opens paths on a Core CONTINUE as recorded, and on a CONTINUE under any other actor (every pre-change record, or a forgery) only when it stands for the user's own continue to the scope question on exactly the waiting paths, otherwise changing nothing; QUESTION_REQUIRED adds to the waiting paths as the live loop does.
regressions.negative_proof: Run before the fix in three stages: unfixed, the forged agent CONTINUE opened the lockfile before any question (local-red-2-unfixed.log); with the actor gate only, a pre-change CONTINUE naming two waiting paths was ignored and the Core re-decided one (local-red-2-actor-gate-only.log); without accumulation the pre-change record could not match (local-red-2-no-accumulation.log). Phase 3 aborts the Core right before it commits its CONTINUE (MODBIT_FAULT_KILL_BEFORE_EVENT) and the next Core records it once.
regressions.limitations: The boundary is the recorded actor, as for DI-9's ProtectedPathsUnlocked: an append forged under the Core's own actor is a log tamper-evidence matter. A question naming protected paths (DI-9) asked while a scope expansion waits also counts as the scope question; narrowing that to questions naming the waiting paths is an open follow-up.
